description: This file defines classes for loading trace data either from ZIP archives or via fetch requests, implementing the TraceLoaderBackend interface.

classes.name: ZipTraceLoaderBackend
classes.description: Handles loading trace data from ZIP files using zip.js library.

classes.name: FetchTraceLoaderBackend
classes.description: Handles loading trace data via fetch API, suitable for live data sources.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the backend with a trace URI and progress callback, setting up ZIP or fetch-based loading.

methods.name: _resolveTraceURI
methods.description: Resolves Dropbox URLs to direct download links.

methods.name: isLive
methods.description: Indicates whether the backend is live (fetch-based) or not (ZIP-based).

methods.name: entryNames
methods.description: Returns a list of entry names available in the trace data.

methods.name: hasEntry
methods.description: Checks if a specific entry exists.

methods.name: readText
methods.description: Reads the content of an entry as text.

methods.name: readBlob
methods.description: Reads the content of an entry as a Blob.

methods.name: _readEntry
methods.description: Fetches a Response object for a given entry name in fetch backend.

methods.name: _readFile
methods.description: Fetches a file from a URI.
